items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'The King of Thailand is a big jazz fan' and 'He had requested us', but Dave Brubeck does not speak about a personal relationship with the King, only responding to the interviewer's statement about the logistical issues of the visit.

ctx.x: Yeah. Then King’s Conservatory in San Jose is where she went from high school. We ran across a recommendation from the dean that she go on in music. Eventually, after having three children and in the ’20s, for some reason she had a insurance policy with Goldman and Sachs. She cashed that in. With that money, which was her money, she was able to go to Europe and study. My father thought it was ridiculous to cash that in. Later on in life, she’d say, “If I hadn’t done that, we’d have lost it all, because Goldman…
Was she your first piano teacher? Did you learn piano from your mother?
